proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ _ p q hp hq
  have key : ∀ r : Seminorm ℝ E, (∀ x, r x = 0 → x = 0) →
      ∃ a > 0, ∃ b > 0, ∀ x, r x ≤ a * ‖(Module.finBasis ℝ E).equivFun x‖ ∧
        ‖(Module.finBasis ℝ E).equivFun x‖ ≤ b * r x := by
    intro r hr
    letI N : NormedAddCommGroup E := AddGroupNorm.toNormedAddCommGroup
      { r.toAddGroupSeminorm with eq_zero_of_map_eq_zero' := hr }
    letI S : NormedSpace ℝ E :=
      { (inferInstance : Module ℝ E) with norm_smul_le := fun c x => (map_smul_eq_mul r c x).le }
    let L := (Module.finBasis ℝ E).equivFun.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    let A : E →L[ℝ] (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ) := L.toContinuousLinearMap
    let B : (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] E := L.symm.toContinuousLinearMap
    refine ⟨‖B‖ + 1, add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg _) one_pos, ‖A‖ + 1,
      add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg _) one_pos, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h1 : ‖B (A x)‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖A x‖ := B.le_opNorm (A x)
      have h3 : B (A x) = x := L.symm_apply_apply x
      rw [h3] at h1
      exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one) (norm_nonneg _))
    · have h1 : ‖A x‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖x‖ := A.le_opNorm x
      exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one) (norm_nonneg _))
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ := key p hp
  obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, h'⟩ := key q hq
  refine ⟨a * d, mul_pos ha hd, c * b, mul_pos hc hb, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · calc p x ≤ a * ‖(Module.finBasis ℝ E).equivFun x‖ := (h x).1
      _ ≤ a * (d * q x) := by gcongr; exact (h' x).2
      _ = a * d * q x := by ring
  · calc q x ≤ c * ‖(Module.finBasis ℝ E).equivFun x‖ := (h' x).1
      _ ≤ c * (b * p x) := by gcongr; exact (h x).2
      _ = c * b * p x := by ring
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (p q : Seminorm ℝ E), (∀ x, p x = 0 → x = 0) → (∀ x, q x = 0 → x = 0) → ∃ C > 0, ∃ D > 0, ∀ x, p x ≤ C * q x ∧ q x ≤ D * p x
